'''Grate toads''' were a type of [[Toad/Legends|toad]] that thrived on heat and waste produced by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life. They could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Y:DR" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Grate toads appeared in ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', a book authored by [[Sean Stewart]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="Y:DR" />
